A few clarifications from our side after an internal sync:

- Purchasing preference: Long-term, PO is preferred. For an initial pilot under $5k we can pay by card to move faster.
- Contracting: Our Legal team will need to review the SOW and our standard PO terms. If Redwood requires any contract amendments, Legal will flag them.
- Signatory path: Tom Nguyen (tom.nguyen@acme.com) is the economic buyer and signs purchases up to $100k. For higher amounts, our CFO signs.
- Finance sponsor: Tom will own the budget approval; Helen Park (helen.park@acme.com) is Procurement and will issue the PO and coordinate DocuSign.
- Marketplace: We prefer direct purchase for pricing flexibility, but AWS Marketplace is considered if procurement wants consolidated billing. Can you outline differences (billing cadence, tax handling, support coverage)?

Hi Sarah, Tom, Helen 

Thanks for the details and for looping folks in. A few quick answers and proposed artifacts to help your teams:

1) Billing differences (direct vs Marketplace)  high level:
   - Direct (Redwood invoice / PO): Monthly invoicing, standard net-30 terms, full flexibility on contract language and SOW. We can accommodate custom SLAs and addenda.
   - AWS Marketplace: Billing consolidated through AWS; pricing must follow Marketplace listing; billing cadence depends on AWS (monthly) but there are limitations on custom contract amendments.

Ive attached a short comparison doc in the PO Process PDF (page 2).

2) Starter artifacts for Legal/Procurement:
   - Redwood-SOW-draft.docx (editable)  use to scope pilot and deliverables.
   - Redwood-PO-Process.pdf  explains PO submission and expected lead times.

3) Signatory mapping table request (one ask from procurement):
   - Can you confirm who needs to approve vs sign, and whether Legal review is required before PO issuance? Example mapping:
     - Budget owner / approver: Tom Nguyen (Finance)
     - Procurement owner / PO issuer: Helen Park (Procurement)
     - Signatory (final contract): Tom Nguyen up to $100k; CFO above $100k
     - Legal review: Yes, for SOW + any contract exceptions
4) Next steps:
   - Tom/Helen: can we schedule 30 min Fri or Mon to confirm signatory mapping and any required contract language?
   - Ill prepare a short redline-friendly SOW and a DocuSign envelope template to speed signature once terms are agreed.

Thanks  Vivek and Aditya are on standby to answer any technical or scope questions during the call.
